descriptions.text: Crafting without punches? Inconceivable! Punches are a quick and easy way to add interest and depth to your projects. Our punches are high quality, affordable, and easy to use. The Banner Triple Punch gives you triple the banner options in one punch. You can make banners in three widths--1", 1-1/2", and 2" (2.5 cm, 3.8 cm and 5.1 cm)--in any length. Just slide the paper in, punch, and get perfectly notched banners (or gift tags, bookmarks, belly bands) every time. * Sleek body style * Large surface area offers precise cutting and leverage * Locks to store * Slim and stackable

images.description: A tan and cream colored paper trimmer or cutter tool with a brown base and white window detail, shown alongside three yellow arrow-shaped die-cut pieces demonstrating the product's cutting capability.

A gray and cream-colored paper punch tool featuring a weather-themed design with clouds and rain drops on the top circular cutting plate. The punch has a rectangular base with a small decorative icon on the front panel and appears to be a manual hand-operated crafting tool.

descriptions.text: Punches are a quick and easy way to add interest and depth to your projects. And there’s no better way to cut out stamped images—many of our stamp sets have coordinating punches. Our punches are high quality, affordable, and easy to use. * Sleek body style * Large surface area offers precise cutting and leverage * Locks to store * Slim and stackable

images.description: A taupe/gray punch tool with a circular opening labeled "1½"" is displayed alongside three white circular punch pieces. The device features a lever mechanism at the bottom and appears to be a handheld circle punch tool designed for cardmaking or paper crafting.

descriptions.text: No more sticky messes! Reach for this when you need whisper-thin strands of glue. The slender precision tip lays down a fine line of glue—great for adhering delicately detailed paper die cuts, teensy embellishments, and bits of glitter. * 1 oz. (30 ml) * Acid free

descriptions.text: Make a colorful impression with our signature ink. (14.8 ml)

descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it's dyed with pure color all the way through so there's no white core. * 24 sheets * Mint Macaron * 8-1/2" x 11" * Acid free * Lignin free
